drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 60-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.65, creatinine 0.71, hemoglobin 12.4, pao2 52, platelets 237, sodium 138, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 70-74, heart_rate 79-84, map 91-94, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-31, sbp 132-138, spo2 88-94, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 12.5, platelets 244, sodium 139, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 79-82, map 91-96, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-27, sbp 132-139, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 60-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
